scope: Fill and appearance rules checked against the locally supplied ISO 32000-2:2020 EC3 text, 12.7.4.3 and 12.7.5.2-12.7.5.4 (Tables 228-234), 12.5.5 and 12.5.6.19 (Table 192). Scalar-value length, CR normalization, auto-size, padding, line wrapping and selection colors are explicit reader policies. Filled page compilation applies temporary appearances without modifying source objects; saving remains outside the API. Null-as-absent entries follow 7.3.9. Text-state setup and the distinction between valid negative font sizes and unsupported generation were checked against 9.3 and 9.4.1 (Tables 102-105). Explicit state reset before DA is generation policy to keep layout independent of an old appearance prefix.

requirements.gaps: Explicit rich replacement and common RV/DS layout/save are covered by content-rich-field-appearance. Plain Text replacement of RichText fields remains refused; XFA and actions remain unsupported or inert. DoNotScroll is checked during appearance generation. Passwords remain in caller-owned memory.
An absent AP permits a generated ZaDb mark; existing state dictionaries are only selected, never replaced.
V contains displayed names per Table 234; exports remain separate. Ambiguity requires explicit option indexes.

requirements.status: implemented as data and filled-page compilation
requirements.gaps: Persistence is covered by filled-form-save. Composite font encoding, oblique Tm and updates containing inline images or multiple Tx sections fail explicitly. Existing Tx sections inside BT or crossing graphics scopes fail explicitly.

requirements.status: implemented for standard rectangular borders and quarter-turn MK R
requirements.gaps: Text boxes with no remaining layout area and richer font/layout behavior remain explicit boundaries. Sixty-four independent pixel controls cover rounded/B/I text, choice and button forms, two resolutions, page rotation, backgrounds, stored Tx updates, BS precedence/nulls, unknown-style fallback, visibility, zero width, absent colour, wide button frames and MK R through filled rendering, tiles, save/reopen and WASI editing. Unequal-axis rounded strokes/dashes and CMYK relief colour expectations remain open. Detailed layout, radius clamping and light/shadow geometry are documented reader policy.
requirements.rule: Fresh text, choice and button appearances share the annotation border reader and fixed rounded/relief geometry. BS takes precedence; null values are absent, malformed styles/negative radii/invalid dashes are syntax errors, and unknown named styles use solid as Table 168 requires. Existing appearance backgrounds remain when only the Tx section is updated. Filled-form artwork retains the initial opaque graphics state and validated MK colours; text inset remains width plus two units when BC is present. Work, geometry and output limits apply before painting. Fresh appearances apply counterclockwise MK R quarter-turns in local coordinates before page placement. Null R means zero; indirect, negative and repeated turns normalize through the shared Rotation type. Invalid values fail explicitly. Existing appearance Matrix and BBox are retained without applying MK R again.

requirements.gaps: Persistence and host editing are covered by their dedicated requirements. Generation retains the supported font and layout capabilities of forms-appearance-update.
Exact rational polygons with tolerance 1; generated bytes use buffer positions rather than invented source identities.
Only visible page widgets are prepared. Direct malformed widgets without a shared source identity cannot be associated by value or name.
NeedAppearances regenerates visible text and choice fields; existing button states are preserved unless changed.

Reader policy: an untouched field with NeedAppearances may retain an existing AP on Unsupported, reported as form.appearance-kept information, valid in Strict mode too. Edited fields and other errors fail explicitly. Source objects are immutable.
